english.legislation: Contrary to sections 73(1)(a) and 76 of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
wilfully obstruct an authorised officer or constable
acting in pursuance of Part II of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976 / the provisions of the Town Police Clauses Act 1847 with respect to Hackney Carriages

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) authorised officer means any officer of a district council authorised in writing by the council for the purposes of this Part of the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1976 - section 80(1) of the 1976 Act
